name: home
description: Home — a self-hosted personal/family cloud ecosystem. This root package.json exists purely to tie every Node-based service and frontend together as one npm workspace, so `npm install` at the repo root installs everything in one pass instead of eight separate `cd X && npm install` steps. It is not itself published or run.
//workspaces: Every folder listed here has its own package.json and can still be developed independently (cd into it, npm run dev — see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md). Listing them explicitly here — rather than a glob like 'apps/*' — is deliberate: apps/homesync-android is a Kotlin/Gradle project with no package.json, and an explicit list means a future new app under apps/ is NOT silently picked up as a workspace until someone adds it here on purpose.
//version-policy: One version number for the whole ecosystem, bumped on every meaningful release across any service — simplest thing that works for a project this size. Individual package.json files under apps/ and packages/ have their own version fields for npm/Docker tooling's sake, but this root version is the one that matters for release notes (see CHANGELOG.md).
//overrides: express@4.x's own dependency tree pulls in a qs version with a known moderate-severity DoS/array-limit-bypass advisory (GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g) that a plain `npm audit fix` can't clear without a breaking Express 5 upgrade. Pinning the patched qs version directly here fixes it without that migration. Safe to remove once every backend's own express dependency naturally resolves to a version that no longer has this problem — check with `npm audit` before removing.

scripts.//test: Runs every workspace's own `test` script, one at a time, stopping at the first failure — homecore, apps/homecloud-backend, apps/homemedia-backend, apps/homenotes-backend, and apps/homesync-backend.
scripts.//install:all: Redundant with plain `npm install` once workspaces are set up (that already installs every workspace's deps) — kept as an explicit, discoverable alias for anyone skimming this file.
scripts.//docker:up: The actual way this whole ecosystem normally runs — see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md. This script is just a memorable shortcut.
scripts.//dev:home: Windows-only convenience launcher — see docs/DEVELOPMENT.md's Windows section. Opens a small picker UI, then starts each chosen service in its own terminal with dev-mode env vars already set. Not needed on macOS/Linux; use the manual per-service commands in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md instead.
